_readme: How the landing page behaves. Its words are admin/content/home.json.
requireOffering  false lets visitors straight through, vandana still shown.
minOfferings     how many offerings unlock the gate.
passKey          the sessionStorage key dge/js/vandana-guard.js looks for.
Change it in both places together, or the guard will bounce
photo            src, alt, frameRatio, objectPosition, and offerX / offerY /
offerW / offerH — where on the arch the flowers come to rest.
flowers          petal colours and sizes, and how many stay settled.
pranam           how many prostration figures the namaskāra button scatters.
